behavior_match: Full path ordering is (distance_mm, hop_count, full edge-ID sequence), with simple paths, not insertion order or only final edge ID.

Checked u128 distance accumulation and checked ceil(distance*ticks_per_second/speed); per-segment cumulative-ceiling differences sum exactly to total duration, including zero-tick segments. Zero tick rate is InvalidTickRate; origin==destination is empty/zero duration; distinct zero-length path remains valid.

Topology canonical bytes are sorted, include graph version and millimetre units, encode edge endpoints/length and sorted allowed modes, and are permutation-invariant. Profile/tick rate are separately exposed by RoutePlan and are not part of topology bytes. No SHA dependency or caller-supplied graph hash is added.

ABM currently has the workspace Rust 1.76 floor and an existing kairo-ecs-des dependency. The proposal requests no dependency/manifest/lock or DES edits. This preserves the one-way ABM-to-DES relationship and DES-to-calibration prohibition.

objections_and_required_dispositions.finding: The frozen contract requires canonical graph bytes to encode a domain/schema tag, graph version, millimetre units, sorted nodes/edges and length-framed modes, but does not specify literal tag bytes, integer endianness or count/string-length widths. The proposal's 'fixed domain/schema tag' and 'fixed-width integers' remain under-specified. Later calibration keys hash these actual bytes, so this is an observable compatibility format.
objections_and_required_dispositions.disposition: Freeze an exact byte layout in the contract/addendum and coordinator decision before dispatch. Candidate layout: ASCII `KAIROS-TRANSIT-GRAPH` followed by NUL; schema version as u32 LE; unit marker bytes `mm` followed by NUL; node_count u64 LE then ascending NodeId values u64 LE; edge_count u64 LE then each edge sorted by EdgeId, with id/from/to/length_mm each u64 LE, followed by allowed_mode_count u64 LE and each mode sorted by raw UTF-8 byte sequence, encoded as byte_length u64 LE then exact bytes. No trailing bytes or Unicode normalization. Checked usize-to-u64 count/length conversion returns Overflow. Numeric NodeId/EdgeId zero remains ordinary data, never a sentinel. This is a proposed format, not yet frozen or authorized. Add an exact canonical-byte golden before downstream hashing is accepted.

objections_and_required_dispositions.finding: The proposal states MovementModeId validation as nonempty, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters and no boundary whitespace. The frozen C20 route contract calls it an exact canonical UTF-8 string and lists invalid mode IDs, but does not freeze those exact rejection rules. The nine fixture cases only assert the empty-string rejection, not byte/control/whitespace limits.
objections_and_required_dispositions.disposition: Either bind the proposed validation rules as an explicit reviewed contract refinement (including no normalization/case-folding and exact UTF-8 byte identity) and add named boundary coverage in a separately bounded fixture update, or remove the extra restrictions from this implementation proposal until frozen. Do not infer these details from the separate fidelity subsystem-ID contract.

objections_and_required_dispositions.finding: The proposal says selected spatial types are re-exported from the ABM crate root, while the frozen contract and ADR-0007 require an experimental `spatial` module and do not require root aliases. Root aliases are an additional public surface and may collide with existing or future ABM names.
objections_and_required_dispositions.disposition: Approve only `pub mod spatial` with the frozen names under `kairo_ecs_abm::spatial::*`; omit crate-root type aliases unless separately enumerated and approved.

objections_and_required_dispositions.finding: The immutable nine-test fixture exercises constructors and routing/time results but does not call every frozen accessor. In particular RoutePlan origin/destination/profile/ticks_per_second/graph_version/graph_canonical_bytes; RouteSegment from/to/length_mm; and MovementProfile getters are not all directly asserted by these nine cases.
objections_and_required_dispositions.disposition: The existing fixture is sufficient for the bounded algorithm/time cases when its nine named tests pass, but API acceptance must independently inspect every exact signature and require a small external production-module API smoke for the omitted getters (including that RoutePlan.graph_canonical_bytes() returns the actual graph bytes and profile/tick getters report the values used). Keep this smoke as a separately reviewed gate if the 2-source-path packet cannot own it.

objections_and_required_dispositions.finding: The proposal says the runner does not explicitly count each named test exactly once. However run_routes_red.py targets the single `spatial_routes_c20` integration test, requires every one of the nine distinct expected `test NAME ... ok` lines, and requires exactly `9 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored`; together these checks imply each named test ran exactly once for this target.
objections_and_required_dispositions.disposition: Correct/remove the stated exact-once caveat. Preserve the runner and fixture unchanged. The recorded green runner receipt plus log is adequate for exact-once within this single-target command, subject to artifact/hash verification.
